firstPlayerRule: Any player deals. The player on the dealer’s left goes first by drawing a card from the dealer’s hand.
clarifications: Before play, everyone discards the pairs in their hand.

sources.title: Old Maid — How to Play
sources.publisher: Bicycle Cards (The United States Playing Card Company)

internalEvidence: Read the Bicycle Cards Old Maid page in a browser. "Any player shuffles the pack and deals them around". "The dealer then offers their hand, spread out face down, to the player on the left, who draws one card from it."
